task_title: AUG-137: one command replays the PRD's 8 success-criteria proofs into a checked-in artifact that fails when a required proof regresses (fix 22bc7aa, graded at the current merged head)
task_criteria: Board AC1: one CI job replays all 8 proofs and records, per proof, pass/fail plus byte counts and wall-clock latency in a checked-in artifact. FAILIF: `scripts/replay_prd_proofs.py --check` exits non-zero, the run does not report 8 proofs, or docs/prd/evidence/AUG-137-prd-proofs.json is absent or untracked. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python scripts/replay_prd_proofs.py --check; echo check_rc=$?; git ls-files docs/prd/evidence/AUG-137-prd-proofs.json -- expect the summary line 'prd proofs: 8 total · 3 required · 5 deferred → PASS', check_rc=0, per-proof lines carrying corpus=<n>B bundle=<n>B latency=<n>ms, and the artifact path printed by git ls-files.

Board AC2: a proof that cannot run is reported NOT RUN, never as a pass, and the overall verdict fails when a REQUIRED proof did not run. FAILIF: an empty corpus passed via --specs-root exits 0, or a required proof is recorded as not-run while the run still reports PASS. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python scripts/replay_prd_proofs.py --check --specs-root $(mktemp -d) > /tmp/empty.log 2>&1; echo empty_rc=$?; grep 'P7' /tmp/empty.log -- expect empty_rc=1 and P7 recorded 'required not-run' with the verdict failing.

Board AC3: the byte and latency numbers come from the run itself, not from prose, and the selected bundle is materially smaller than the full corpus it was selected from. FAILIF: the P7 proof line carries no measured corpus/bundle sizes, the bundle size is greater than or equal to the corpus size, or --check accepts an artifact whose recorded numbers disagree with a fresh run. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python scripts/replay_prd_proofs.py --check --artifact /tmp/absent.json > /tmp/stale.log 2>&1; echo stale_rc=$? -- expect the live P7 line to read corpus=9249B bundle=2944B and '31.8% of the corpus (2944 of 9249 bytes)', and stale_rc=1 for a missing artifact.

The replay is enforced by a LIVE gate arm, not a comment, and its unusable-prerequisite path lands in the required-arm list instead of a silent skip. FAILIF: tests/gate.sh contains no `replay_prd_proofs.py --check` invocation, or the arm's fallback does not call skip_required_arm with the name 'prd-proofs'. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && grep -n 'replay_prd_proofs.py --check' tests/gate.sh; grep -n 'skip_required_arm "prd-proofs"' tests/gate.sh -- expect both present (the invocation exits 1 on failure and the skip path names prd-proofs).

The replay's own suite is green and named in the gate's pytest arm, and the row's landed fix is an ancestor of the judged tree. FAILIF: any test in tests/test_prd_proofs.py fails, fewer than 18 tests are collected, the file is absent from the gate's pytest arm, or the ancestry check exits non-zero. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_prd_proofs.py; grep -c tests/test_prd_proofs.py tests/gate.sh; git merge-base --is-ancestor 22bc7aa687eeced20b1ca79678fb4fafb6b37109 HEAD; echo ancestor_rc=$? -- expect '18 passed', count 1, ancestor_rc=0.

Code path: scripts/replay_prd_proofs.py:520-522 records `not-run` on ProofNotRun (never `pass`), and build_report:562-566 sets `verdict = "fail" if required_bad else "pass"` where required_bad is every required proof whose status != pass; main:735-741 returns 1 on a non-pass verdict. Pinned by tests/test_prd_proofs.py:343 test_a_required_proof_forced_to_not_run_fails_the_verdict.

items.criterion: Board AC3: the byte and latency numbers come from the run itself, not from prose, and the selected bundle is materially smaller than the full corpus it was selected from. FAILIF: the P7 proof line carries no measured corpus/bundle sizes, the bundle size is greater than or equal to the corpus size, or --check accepts an artifact whose recorded numbers disagree with a fresh run. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python scripts/replay_prd_proofs.py --check --artifact /tmp/absent.json > /tmp/stale.log 2>&1; echo stale_rc=$? -- expect the live P7 line to read corpus=9249B bundle=2944B and '31.8% of the corpus (2944 of 9249 bytes)', and stale_rc=1 for a missing artifact.
items.detail: Ran the exact PROOF: `stale_rc=1` with `prd-proofs: /tmp/absent.json is missing — record a run`, and the live P7 line reads `corpus=9249B bundle=2944B latency=128.3ms  4/12 blocks selected by `applies-to auger.spec.select`; bundle is 31.8% of the corpus (2944 of 9249 bytes)`. Numbers are measured, not prose: scripts/replay_prd_proofs.py:441-443 `_corpus_bytes` sums `os.stat` over the corpus *.xml; :487 `bundle_bytes = out.stat().st_size` of the assembler's own `--out` file; :486 latency is `time.perf_counter()` around the subprocess; :497-500 asserts `ratio <= SIZE_FRACTION_FLOOR` (0.60) and :492-496 asserts the selection excludes blocks. Disagreement is caught: I copied the artifact, set P7 `bundle_bytes=9999`, and `--check --artifact /tmp/art.json` returned `tamper_rc=1` with `disagrees with this run — ... a recorded byte count is stale`, because `_signature` (:600-616) includes corpus_bytes/bundle_bytes.

items.detail: Both greps hit: `tests/gate.sh:330:  python3 scripts/replay_prd_proofs.py --check || exit 1` (a live invocation that exits 1 on failure) and `tests/gate.sh:332:  skip_required_arm "prd-proofs" "scripts/replay_prd_proofs.py or docs/prd/xml-spec-graph-proofs.json missing from the checkout — arm NOT run, NOT passed"`. `skip_required_arm` is defined at tests/gate.sh:124-127 and appends the name to `REQUIRED_SKIPPED`, which the closing summary turns into `GATE FAIL: required arms did not run` + `exit 1` (tests/gate.sh:382-391) — not a silent skip. The arm sits outside the DOC_ONLY branches (unlike pytest at :225 and smoke at :260), so it runs in both gate modes.

PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_prd_proofs.py; grep -c tests/test_prd_proofs.py tests/gate.sh; git merge-base --is-ancestor 22bc7aa687eeced20b1ca79678fb4fafb6b37109 HEAD; echo ancestor_rc=$? -- expect '18 passed', count 1, ancestor_rc=0.
items.detail: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_prd_proofs.py` -> `21 passed in 8.22s` (21 collected, above the 18 floor; 21 `def test_` functions confirmed by grep). `grep -c tests/test_prd_proofs.py tests/gate.sh` -> `1` (named in the pytest arm at tests/gate.sh:206). `git merge-base --is-ancestor 22bc7aa687eeced20b1ca79678fb4fafb6b37109 HEAD` -> `ancestor_rc=0`; that commit is `22bc7aa test(ci): pin the prd-proof verdict on both a forced fail and a forced not-run`. LSP diagnostics: 0 findings.

items.criterion: The 8 proofs replayed are the PRD's own 8 success-criteria bullets (parsed from docs/prd/xml-spec-graph.md '## Success criteria — replayable proofs'), not a hand-written list, and every bullet is reconciled against the reviewed allowlist by sha256 so a bullet cannot be silently dropped or reordered.
items.detail: `.venv/bin/python scripts/replay_prd_proofs.py --print-prd-proofs` prints `8 proof(s) in /home/kara/auger/docs/prd/xml-spec-graph.md — '## Success criteria — replayable proofs'` with P1..P8 sha256s that match the allowlist entries in docs/prd/xml-spec-graph-proofs.json (e.g. P7 `af41461643eb...`). parse_prd_proofs (scripts/replay_prd_proofs.py:110-146) parses the bullets; reconcile (:150-215) raises CoverageError for an unclassified bullet, a stale allowlist entry, or an out-of-order id, and main returns 1. Pinned by tests/test_prd_proofs.py:57,68,98,107,119.

items.criterion: The gate arm is actually reachable in the repo's real gate entrypoint (tests/gate.sh, the configured guards.test_command) and its failure propagates to a non-zero gate exit rather than being swallowed.
items.detail: .gitreins/config.yaml sets `test_command: bash tests/gate.sh`, and tests/gate.sh:329-333 runs `python3 scripts/replay_prd_proofs.py --check || exit 1` unconditionally (not inside the DOC_ONLY branches at :225/:260), so it executes in both gate modes; a non-zero replay exits the gate immediately. The prerequisite-missing branch calls skip_required_arm "prd-proofs" (:332) -> REQUIRED_SKIPPED (:124-127) -> `GATE FAIL: required arms did not run` + `exit 1` (:382-391).

items.criterion: The artifact's recorded byte counts are part of the --check comparison, so a stale/edited number (not just a changed verdict) makes --check red.
items.detail: _signature (scripts/replay_prd_proofs.py:600-616) includes `corpus_bytes` and `bundle_bytes` per proof, and --check compares `_signature(committed) != _signature(report)` (:706-720). Empirically: a copy of the artifact with P7 `bundle_bytes` changed to 9999 made `--check --artifact /tmp/art.json` return `tamper_rc=1` with `disagrees with this run — ... a recorded byte count is stale`. Pinned by tests/test_prd_proofs.py:481 and :496.

items.criterion: The replay is deterministic/idempotent: re-running --check on the same tree twice, and re-recording the artifact, does not produce spurious drift (latency excluded from the signature).
items.detail: Two consecutive `--check` runs on the same tree both returned rc=0 with `agrees with this run` (latency differed between runs: 116.3ms vs 116.2ms vs 128.3ms, yet no drift). latency_ms is deliberately excluded from _signature (comment at scripts/replay_prd_proofs.py:610-612) while byte counts are included. Pinned by tests/test_prd_proofs.py:522 test_check_mode_ignores_only_the_timings and :250 test_the_artifact_check_agrees_under_a_differently_named_interpreter.
